title: Roman theatre of Dougga
geometryBasis: Native OpenStreetMap alignment, survey-published seating and stage dimensions, and original Mapzen terrain values over the hill.
sectionBasis: The CC0 2025 view shows a stepped horseshoe cavea with sector stairs, broad low first rings, low orchestra in front of the platform, and disconnected groups of column bases, lintels, partial wall and broken shafts behind the stage.
limitations: The standing and restored theatre is represented as a ruin. Stone fractures, angles and individual column remnants are approximated using the cleared view and published dimensions.
The associated archaeological precinct and inaccessible spaces below the stands are outside scope.
